title: ApprovalResult
description: Outcome of a human approval (§19). Non-reusable: one approval_ref authorizes exactly one idempotent action. `consumed=true` once the authorized action has posted; replay with the same ref is then rejected.

decision.description: The captured decision. `request_changes` returns the request to the requester for revision (terminal for that approval_ref — §19 non-reusable: the requester must submit a new packet → new trace → new ref).

second_approver_ref.description: Required for dual-control: the second distinct approver's Keycloak sub (§19).

idempotency_key.description: The key to replay on the authorized POST (§10).

consumed.description: True once the authorized action has posted; further replay is rejected (§19 non-reusable).
